（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Shanghai Municipal Council.
No 447
Date 15/7/16

14th July 1916

Sir,
Dr Sun Yat Sen, Huang Hsin, Tang Shao Yi, Pah
Won Wei, Wen Tsung Yao and a few other prominent
members of the Kuomintang entertained one hundred
and forty eight members of Parliament to tiffin
in the Palace Hotel on 13th inst. Tang Shao Yi
presided. Several short speeches were made urging
the necessity of unity and unselfishness in order
to save the country. The speakers included Dr.
Sun Yat Sen, Huang Hsin, Tang Shao Yi, Tsang Chi,
Chairman of the Senate, and Wong Tsung Ding, &
Vice Chairman of the House of Representatives.

It is reported that the cruiser "Hai Chu",
the flag ship of Admiral Li, is not at Woosung now.
None of the military officials here know where
she has gone to.

It is reported that there is slight unrest
among the troops in Woosung, who are dissatisfied
because a gratuity of 2 months' pay, which is
said to be in the hands of Deputy Military Governor
Lu, has not been paid.

Your obedient servant,

McLaren
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探科。）

上海工部局。
第 447 号
日期 16/7/15

1916年7月14日

先生：

孙中山博士、黄兴、唐绍仪、柏文蔚、温宗尧以及国民党其他几位知名成员，于本月13日在汇中饭店（Palace Hotel）设午宴招待一百四十八名国会议员。唐绍仪担任主席。会上发表了数篇简短演讲，呼吁为了救国必须实现团结和无私。演讲者包括孙中山博士、黄兴、唐绍仪、参议院议长臧致平以及众议院副议长王宠惠等。

据报，李督军的旗舰“海筹”号巡洋舰目前不在吴淞。此间的军方官员均不知其去向。

据报，吴淞驻军中出现轻微骚动，士兵们因未收到据说已由副督军卢永祥掌握的两个月薪水赏金而感到不满。

您顺从的仆人，

麦克拉伦
首席探长

警务处总监
